## createHofAsync(handler) ⇒ <code>HofFn&lt;K, &quot;async&quot;&gt;</code>
Builds an async fn-first HOF from a core handler. See
[createHofSync](#createHofSync) for the shared bypass semantics; the only difference
is the per-call predicate, which may be async (its result is awaited
before deciding whether to bypass).

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>HofFn&lt;K, &quot;async&quot;&gt;</code> - The new fn-first HOF taking `(fn, options)`.  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| handler | <code>Hof&lt;K, AnyAsyncFunction&gt;</code> | The core handler building the enhanced wrapper; called exactly once per wrap. |
